# Blueline Surf & Paddle Co. website concept (by Suede AI)

> Independent, uncommissioned website design concept for a Jupiter, Florida surf and paddle shop, designed and built by Jason Colapietro, founder and CEO of Suede AI in West Palm Beach, Florida. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Blueline Surf & Paddle Co. Products, prices, ratings, reviews and staff on the concept homepage are illustrative placeholders, so the homepage is not indexed. The notes below are original articles by Suede AI.

## Notes
- [Case study: a Jupiter surf and paddle shop website concept by Suede AI](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/blueline-surf-concept/notes/jupiter-surf-shop-website-case-study/): how the conditions-first concept was designed (Open-Meteo marine data, NOAA CO-OPS station 8722670 tides) and what a real build would add.
- [Surf report, rentals and lessons: the pages a coastal Florida shop actually needs](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/blueline-surf-concept/notes/surf-report-rentals-lessons-pages/): a one-page-one-question plan for shops in Jupiter and Palm Beach County, written for search and AI answers.
- [How Jason Colapietro approaches small-business web development in Jupiter and Palm Beach County](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/blueline-surf-concept/notes/small-business-web-development-jupiter/): working method, engineering habits and proof-linked claims.
- [Booking flows for lessons and rentals: reducing drop-off on a Jupiter shop concept](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/blueline-surf-concept/notes/booking-flows-lessons-rentals-jupiter/): the five steps where surf lesson and rental bookings lose people (product, slot, details, payment, confirmation) and the fixes, from price-first panels to weather policies.
- [Seasonal landing pages for a coastal shop: snowbird season, summer camps and storm closures (Juno Beach and Tequesta)](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/blueline-surf-concept/notes/seasonal-landing-pages-juno-beach-tequesta/): three year-round seasonal pages for a surf shop, with local detail instead of doorway pages.
